Subject: Request: security/integration readout — initial availability

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with Redwood’s throughput and the quantization options. Our security and procurement teams want a short integration readout focused on data flows, encryption, and deployment models before procurement signs off.

Attendees we plan to include:
- Samir Patel (Staff SWE, platform) — security lead (me)
- Lydia Gomez (IT Security Manager) — security reviewer
- Procurement inbox (procurement@acmeanalytics.com) — contracting items

Can you suggest availability next week for a 60-minute session that includes:
- High-level architecture and data flow between Acme and Redwood (10–15m)
- Security/compliance evidence: SOC 2, data retention, KMS, encryption-at-rest/in-transit (25–30m)
- Open Q&A and next steps for procurement (15–20m)

I’ve attached our standard security questionnaire to help you prepare. Please let me know who from Redwood should attend (AE, SE, sec/compliance). Also flag any pre-reads you want us to review.

Thanks,
Samir
---

We’ll cover during the 60-minute session:
- 10m — architecture & deployment modes (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private)
- 25m — controls: encryption (KMS/HSM), data retention, access controls, logging/audit
- 15m — evidence & procurement ask: SOC 2 report cadence, contract SLAs, support model
- 10m — Q&A and next steps

Action items for Redwood (completed before meeting):
- Share public egress IP ranges and port requirements: see link below
- Provide a sample statement of data handling and retention

Links/resources:
- Egress IP ranges: https://redwood.example.com/egress-ips
- Compliance drive (SOC2 report, pen test summary): https://drive.google.com/open?id=redwood-compliance-drive

If Acme needs deeper dives (KMS integration, on-prem options), we can schedule a follow-up with our infra team. We will not include any customer data in the recording.

Looking forward to Tuesday 2028-03-29 10:00 PST. I’ll send a short run of show and a calendar invite momentarily.

Cheers,
